title: Fire Alarm — Long Term Parking Deck

lines.text: AOC, this is Garage 1. We have a confirmed fire alarm activation in the Long Term Parking Deck, Level 2. Smoke is visible near Door 7. We're initiating a manual pull and have evacuated the area.
Garage 1, confirm: is the alarm from a smoke detector, or was it manually pulled?
Manual pull, AOC. We saw a flash near the utility closet. No fire yet, but the alarm is active and the door is blocked by debris. We need fire response now.
Garage 1, standby. Dispatching Akron Fire Department. Do not re-enter until confirmed safe. Evacuate to Shelter B.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, urgent, breathless, with background noise of distant sirens

instructorNote: Red herring inject; the fire alarm is fake and part of the cyberattack. The security team may be distracted by the call, but the terminal FIDS and BHS issues remain unresolved. Watch for overreaction to the garage alarm.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: Pull nearest alarm, report to 911 or the ACC. Fire alarm activation mandates full immediate EVACUATION (Section 3). Akron Fire Department (AFD) assumes IC on arrival.

citations.documentTitle: North Coast International Airport (NCIA) — Airport Terminal Incident Response Plan (TIRP)
citations.quote: - Ops: confirm 911 notification; activate EVACUATION; announce "A fire has been reported. Evacuate the terminal immediately. Use the nearest exit."; establish contact with Fire IC at Command Post. - L
